page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number 70 at top right. Verse epitaph in italic lines above a rule; below the rule a heading and a block of verse epitaph in roman and italic. No marginal notes of text.

main_text.head: N. FABRICII NORLINGEN- sis, infimæ puerorum Scholæ, in discendis primis literarum & Logistices rudimentis Magistri, diu & singulari cum laude, hoc munere defuncti, Memoriæ.

p.i: Aptet auarus opes, petat ambitiosus honores. Huius quos Vitæ simulachrũ fallit inane: Rectius ô quanto Vixit Fabricius ille,

Quæ pueros inter medium, tenerámque iuuentam, Litterulas patria monstrantem pingere lingua, Et numerorum arte mira simul arte docentem, Coniuge post decadas septé, & tres insuper annos Elata, nonam decada, anno Vix minus Sno, Explentem, ætatis placidè sanctéque peractæ, Dilexit Siuum, deflet Norlinga sepultum.

page.notes: Upper verse is a partly damaged italic passage; readings such as "Cantilla", "Setrum", "Vres", "Sonisque", "Sandoremque", "Nulla" are doubtful. Numerals "Vix", "Sno", "Siuum" and similar are uncertain. Bottom-left and right of the page show only faint marks, not transcribed.
